stories.title: Whaley the Giant of the Sea
learning_objectives: A blue whale is the largest animal on Earth
Ocean water is salty
Deep ocean can be dark and cold
Whales breathe air using a blowhole
Whales use tails to swim

pages.text: Whaley is a blue whale, the biggest animal on Earth. He lives in the wide ocean and swims slowly, calmly, and gently.
pages.image_prompt: Flat pastel illustration of a friendly giant blue whale smiling in a bright blue ocean, simple shapes, kid-friendly, soft shading, consistent character design across pages. 1:1 aspect ratio.

pages.text: The ocean is huge. Some places are shallow and sunny, and some places are very deep, cold, and dark.
pages.image_prompt: Flat pastel cross-section of ocean from sunny surface to dark deep water, simple gradient, cute fish silhouettes, educational toddler style, consistent character design across pages. 1:1 aspect ratio.

pages.text: Ocean water is salty. It tastes salty, not sweet. Salt is mixed into the water everywhere in the sea.
pages.image_prompt: Flat pastel scene of a small cup labeled 'salty ocean' with a smiling wave icon, simple educational symbols, kid-friendly, consistent character design across pages. 1:1 aspect ratio.

pages.text: Whaley swishes his strong tail up and down. That tail push helps him move forward through heavy water.
pages.image_prompt: Flat pastel whale tail swishing with gentle motion lines and bubbles, simple diagram-like style, cheerful, consistent character design across pages. 1:1 aspect ratio.

pages.text: Even though Whaley lives in water, he must breathe air. He cannot breathe underwater like fish can.
pages.image_prompt: Flat pastel whale near surface with a thought bubble showing air clouds, plus a fish with gills icon, simple and clear, consistent character design across pages. 1:1 aspect ratio.

pages.text: Whaley swims up to the surface. He blows air out through his blowhole, making a tall spray called a spout.
pages.image_prompt: Flat pastel whale surfacing with a cute water spout, soft sky, gentle waves, minimal details, consistent character design across pages. 1:1 aspect ratio.

pages.text: Whaley eats tiny food called krill. He opens his mouth wide, then filters the water and keeps the krill.
pages.image_prompt: Flat pastel whale with open mouth and tiny pink krill dots, simple filtering idea with arrows, toddler-friendly, consistent character design across pages. 1:1 aspect ratio.

pages.text: Some ocean parts are so deep that sunlight cannot reach. Down there, it can feel very dark and quiet.
pages.image_prompt: Flat pastel deep-sea scene with dim light fading, small glowing dots, calm mood, simple shapes, consistent character design across pages. 1:1 aspect ratio.

pages.text: Whaley listens to sounds in the water. Whales can make calls, and sound can travel far in the ocean.
pages.image_prompt: Flat pastel whale with musical note icons traveling as waves, simple sound-wave lines, friendly style, consistent character design across pages. 1:1 aspect ratio.

pages.text: Whaley keeps swimming, breathing air, and eating krill. The ocean is his home, and he helps it stay healthy.
pages.image_prompt: Flat pastel ocean scene with whale, krill, and happy sea plants, gentle pastel palette, warm kid-friendly feel, consistent character design across pages. 1:1 aspect ratio.

pages.text: At bedtime, we remember: the biggest whale lives in salty water, and deep ocean can be cold, dark, and calm.

stories.title: Ollie the Octopus with Eight Arms
learning_objectives: An octopus has eight arms

pages.text: Ollie returns to his den to rest. Eight arms curl up softly, and the ocean stays calm around him.

stories.title: Daisy the Dolphin Who Uses Echoes
learning_objectives: Dolphins are mammals
Dolphins breathe air at the surface

pages.image_prompt: Flat pastel dolphin jumping with splash, happy ocean, simple shapes, bright cheerful mood, consistent character design across pages. 1:1 aspect ratio.

pages.text: Daisy remembers: breathe at the surface, swim with the pod, and use echoes to find food safely.
pages.image_prompt: Flat pastel summary-style scene: dolphin surfacing, pod nearby, echo lines toward fish, simple icons, consistent character design across pages. 1:1 aspect ratio.

pages.text: At the end of the day, Daisy rests and floats quietly. Her pod stays close in the calm ocean.

stories.title: Tina the Sea Turtle and the Long Swim
